_comment: Sample rule ledger for POSITION_SOURCE=ledger. Copy to positions.json.
Each entry is an instruction the human authored on the desk: which coin,
what target, what stop. The keeper only ever executes these — it never
authors one, and it never acts on a delegate that has no entry here.
entryPrice is USDC per whole token at the moment the human bought.

positions.user: <the user's wallet pubkey — they keep custody>
